title: Zillah
summary: A wife of Lamech, and the mother of Tubal-cain and Naamah (Genesis 4:19, 4:22). Raleigh prints Silla.
description: A wife of Lamech, and the mother of Tubal-cain and Naamah (Genesis 4:19, 4:22). Raleigh prints Silla, in the line of Lamech and beside Ada, Iubal, Tubal, and Tubalcain. No mother or spouse field is stored, so Lamech is Related and is not recorded as her father. Undated in this intake: no CFAH year was found. Raleigh is display-only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
